result.planSummary: Added the Story 0 SQLite foundation without changing the active runtime store: installed the SQLite dependency, introduced a migrated per-thread `thread.sqlite` store with compatibility methods, added SQLite-aware temp-store helpers, and shipped the partial file-backed migration smoke plus focused Chunk 0 tests.

changedFiles.reason: Added `better-sqlite3` runtime dependency and SQLite typings for the new store foundation.
Recorded the SQLite dependency graph needed for deterministic installs.
Extended structured issue codes with SQLite and migration-specific error variants used by the new foundation.
Added the initial SQLite schema migration for thread, actor, message, turn, chunk, import, and projection tables.
Implemented the SQLite-backed thread store, migration runner, DB lifecycle helpers, snapshot seeding, and compatibility CRUD methods.
Added the Story 0 migration smoke service that partially imports legacy file-backed identity and message state into SQLite.
Re-exported the SQLite store through the context-steward surface for shared test/helper usage.
Added backing-aware temp-store helpers so tests can explicitly request file or SQLite stores.
Extended async-thread test helpers to expose the new backing-aware and SQLite-specific temp-store helpers.
Covered SQLite DB creation, migration application, on-disk persistence, and reopen behavior.
Added simple compatibility smoke coverage for `openThread`, `writeTurns`, `readChunks`, and `writeChunks` on SQLite.
Verified test helpers can explicitly choose file or SQLite backing and that realistic fixtures persist through the SQLite path.
Added the migration smoke proving legacy file-backed state can be partially imported into SQLite without runtime cutover.

findingsFixed: Implemented real file-backed SQLite persistence and reopen coverage instead of using in-memory shortcuts.
Kept runtime behavior unchanged while adding a Promise-shaped SQLite store and migration rails for later cutover stories.
Added explicit file-vs-SQLite test helper support so later production-path tests can opt into the active backing.

result.recommendedNextStep: Run verification review for Story 0, with special attention on keeping runtime default store selection unchanged until the later cutover story.
